# Hoplink

> Hoplink is a developer-first short link platform: create branded short links through a REST API, a web dashboard, a Node.js SDK or a CLI, see who clicks them (clicks, unique visitors, referrers, countries, by day or by hour), and get every event pushed to your own systems as signed webhooks.

Hoplink is built for product, marketing and growth teams at software companies who need short links they can create from code, track, and connect to their own tools.

## Product

- Links: short links with a generated or custom slug, tags, an expiry date, a fallback URL for archived or expired links, archive and delete. Bulk creation of up to 100 links per request.
- Click analytics: total clicks, unique visitors (privacy-preserving hash, no IPs stored), clicks by day or by hour, top referrers and countries.
- Webhooks: link.created, link.updated, link.deleted and link.clicked events, signed with HMAC-SHA256 (Hoplink-Signature header), retried up to 3 times.
- Dashboard: create and manage links, view stats and charts, download QR codes, manage webhook endpoints.
- Node.js SDK (@hoplink/node): typed client with automatic retries and webhook signature verification.
- CLI (hoplink): shorten links, list them and read stats from a terminal.

## API basics

- Base URL: https://api.hoplink.dev, versioned by date (Hoplink-Version header).
- Auth: bearer API keys, hl_test_ (test) and hl_live_ (live).
- Limits: 100 requests per minute per key; cursor pagination with limit and starting_after.
- Errors: one JSON shape, { "error": { "type", "code", "message", "param" } }.
